children.text: Free cedar sharpener on orders over $35 · code CEDAR
One pencil, skipped free, for every new sketchbook wing.
One cedar sharpener a quarter, mailed.
Every Graphite No. 2 boxed before Sunday ships with a cedar sharpener.
“The No. 2 is the one you reach for on Monday“
A note a month, plus first dibs.
New woods, workshop leftovers and the occasional pencil.
